parent_objective: execute bounded public routing smoke over 12 controller profiles and a small executable task-source subset
blocked_by: need measured routing-smoke evidence before full 864-cell rollout design or execution
supersedes: direct full rollout execution after M1685

public_gates: M1686 may run bounded public environment rollout only for routing smoke
M1686 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1686 must run 12 profiles over at least 4 executable public specs
M1686 must report episode profile and spec aggregates with finite selected metrics
M1686 must not claim controller-family ranking paper-level evidence or level3 self-ID
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M1615 hidden tensors or actions as benchmark targets

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: executes small public routing smoke before full rollout
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: routing smoke only; environment rollout allowed, but no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if profile checkpoints/configs are missing
stop if P0 actor contract is violated
stop if runner exceptions or non-finite metrics occur
stop if profile-specific tuning or private holdout is used
fallback_plan: route to routing smoke audit if pass
route to runner repair if plumbing fails
route to measured-execution redesign if executable spec mapping is invalid
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1685 admits exactly one small public routing smoke before full rollout

admission_evidence: M1685 designs two-stage smoke-then-full execution and keeps controller ranking blocked
allowed_updates: M1686 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: episode profile and spec aggregate metrics are finite
next audit or repair route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; routing smoke must include L1, L2-current-tiled, and L3-reset profiles but cannot claim history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: routing smoke must report profile coverage
routing smoke must not claim ranking or self-ID from small public execution
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1685 design and M1683 protocol only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If smoke results look negative or positive, record them as routing diagnostics until audited and scaled.
allowed_claims: routing smoke execution and plumbing status
no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded public routing smoke can execute the 12 controller profiles on a small executable task-source subset with clean guardrails and finite metrics.
success_criteria: training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: episode count profile count or spec count is below target
runner exceptions or non-finite selected metrics occur
training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
smoke claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID

commands.name: routing_smoke
commands.command: run bounded public routing smoke over M1674 profile checkpoints and executable task-source subset

decision_rule: M1686 passes if it executes the bounded public routing smoke with complete artifacts finite metrics and clean guardrails.
